draft.title: Reducing regional inequality
card: Regional inequality is a gap in wellbeing between regions of one country. People in poorer regions, often rural or remote, may have lower incomes, poorer health and fewer years of schooling.
Governments can run programs to narrow this gap. They often build roads, clinics and schools in the regions that have the least.
Roads link farmers to markets and people to services. Clinics improve health. Schools raise skills, which can lead to better paid work later.

In rural Papua New Guinea and Indonesia, remote villages can be far from towns, so governments in both countries use programs like these. The aim is to lift wellbeing in the poorer regions, not only in the cities.
draft.remember: Governments narrow the wellbeing gap between regions by building services where people have the least.

opts: A gap in wellbeing between regions of one country
A gap in wellbeing between two different countries
A gap in wellbeing between men and women in a town
A gap in the size of population between two regions
a.why: Regional inequality compares regions inside one country, such as rural villages and a capital city. A gap between countries is a different comparison, and it is the most tempting wrong option.
a.clue: Think about where the regions are located.

b.q: A government in a rural region has few clinics and few schools. Which program would best help narrow the gap with richer regions?
opts: Building clinics and schools in the poorer region
Building more airports in the richest city
Cutting the number of roads in rural areas
Moving all services into the capital city
b.why: Clinics and schools put health and education services where people have the least, which raises wellbeing in the poorer region. Moving services to the capital would leave rural people further behind.
b.clue: Which option adds services to the region with the least?

a.best: A gap in wellbeing between regions of one country

b.best: Building clinics and schools in the poorer region

problems.detail: The stem 'A government in a rural region has few clinics and few schools' says the government has few clinics, not the region. It should read something like 'A rural region has few clinics and few schools.'
